How the calculator works

All the maal of players who have seen is added together. Each player then gets their maal × number of players − total maal. Players who haven't seen the maal count as zero maal. On top of that, every losing player pays the winner a fixed amount: 3 points if they had seen, 10 if they hadn't (you can change these in the options).

Example with 4 players: the winner has 8 maal, two others have 3 and 0, and one player never saw (total maal 11). Before fees that is +21, +1, −11 and −11. After fees (3 + 3 + 10 to the winner) it's +37, −2, −14, −21 — it always adds up to zero.

Use Settle up at the end of the night to see the fewest transfers that square everyone. Need a refresher? See the Marriage rules, maal and tiplu points.
